mission.mission_statement: A quiet, long-range bluewater explorer for private guests, expedition equipment and remote operations; prioritise service reliability, comfort, maintainability and low lifecycle energy rather than top speed.
mission.operating_region: Global bluewater routes; polar and restricted-area operations are excluded until route-specific requirements and approvals are defined.
mission.route_profile: Provisional long-range displacement mission; route, reserve policy, weather window and resupply cadence require an explicit mission profile.

target_cruise_speed_kn.rationale: Provisional economic-speed target for trade studies; not a hydrodynamic prediction.

target_range_nmi.rationale: Provisional range target at the declared economic speed, with reserves to be specified.

voyage_duration_days.rationale: Working mission duration to expose consumables, storage and maintenance constraints.

port_calls.rationale: Depends on route and resupply design.

length_overall_m.rationale: Archetype size selected to scope first trade studies only.

beam_m.rationale: Set after intact/damage stability, deck arrangement and resistance trade studies.

design_draft_m.rationale: Set against propulsor, machinery, stability and intended port constraints.

air_draft_m.rationale: Depends on wind-assist concept, radar/communications mast and heli/tender choices.

displacement_tonnes.rationale: Requires a mass and vertical-centre budget; no displacement estimate claimed.

guest_capacity.rationale: Working concept capacity; not a final accommodation or safe-manning decision.

crew_capacity.rationale: Working operational assumption; requires mission, hotel services and manning review.

vehicle_or_cargo_capacity.rationale: Tender, science kit, stores and garage volume not yet sized.

operating_profile.sea_state_envelope: To be set by route/weather return-period study and stability/seakeeping analysis; no safe operating envelope implied.
operating_profile.weather_routing: Compare fixed schedule with weather-aware speed and route policies; hard route/crew/guest comfort limits override fuel savings.
operating_profile.speed_policy: Use economic speed as an optimisation decision, subject to schedule, sea state, machinery envelope and comfort.

availability_target.rationale: Provisional mission availability target; exclude planned maintenance explicitly and validate with reliability model.

energy_architecture.distribution_architecture: Compare zonal DC/AC microgrid layouts with segregated essential services, black-start and safe degraded modes.
propulsion_candidates: battery-buffered electric propulsion with dispatchable onboard generation
battery-electric mission variant if the route/charging mass-energy balance closes
energy_carriers_to_evaluate: renewable diesel/HVO with lifecycle feedstock sensitivity
hydrogen fuel-cell option with storage/volume/safety review

battery_capacity_mwh.rationale: Size only after propulsion load curve, hotel load, reserve, thermal/fire zones and battery mass are modelled.

energy_architecture.shore_power: Model availability and charging duration at each planned port; no universal shore-power availability is assumed.
energy_architecture.wind_assist: Evaluate retractable wing-sails or other wind-assist only after stability, rig loads, visibility, air-draft, tender and emergency-access analysis.
energy_architecture.solar_assist: Treat solar as a measured area/irradiance contribution; don't count rated peak power as continuous voyage energy.
energy_architecture.thermal_integration: Integrate heat pumps, heat recovery, insulated distribution and thermal storage after mode-resolved hotel-load accounting.

propulsion_kw.rationale: Requires resistance/propulsor, speed, draft, fouling and sea-state model.

hvac_kw.rationale: Climate, occupancy, envelope, ventilation and setpoint model required.

freshwater_kw.rationale: Freshwater production/storage schedule and waste-heat opportunities required.

waste_treatment_kw.rationale: Treatment rates, regulatory discharge limits and pump duty cycle required.

galley_kw.rationale: Appliance load inventory and meal-service duty cycle required.

port_mode_kw.rationale: Quiet anchorage and berth hotel-load modes need separate measurements/estimates.

load_budget.basis: No kW or MWh load is fabricated at concept stage. Build hourly mode profiles and preserve uncertainty before selecting energy capacity.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Same guest capacity, mission, speed/schedule and reserve policy; disclose fuel/electricity pathway and lifecycle boundaries.
performance_targets.validation_method: Route-level energy balance plus independently reviewed fuel/electricity emission factors; later validate against measured voyage data.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Only at berths with adequate shore power or verified zero-direct-emission supply; report upstream emissions separately.
performance_targets.validation_method: Port-specific power and energy-carrier ledger plus operational verification.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Functionally equivalent yacht mission and guest-service specification.
performance_targets.validation_method: Measured/validated route-energy model with sea-state, speed, occupancy and hotel-load sensitivity.

performance_targets.comparison_basis: Prespecified adversarial and bounded-bias suite; feasibility remains separate from performance score.
performance_targets.validation_method: Negative-control suite with evaluator-hidden truth, uncertainty and fault injections.

hard_constraints.description: Intact and damage stability over declared loads, tank states, wind rig configurations and flooding cases.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Approved stability booklet or equivalent qualified naval-architecture analyses under applicable flag/class rules.

hard_constraints.description: Hull, foundations, mast/wing rig and machinery foundation strength and fatigue.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Structural calculations and required class/flag review.

hard_constraints.description: Battery, fuel, machinery and accommodation fire detection, containment, suppression and escape routes.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Energy-carrier-specific hazard analysis and applicable statutory/class review.

hard_constraints.description: Manoeuvring, propulsion redundancy and safe degraded operation.
Sewage, greywater, bilge, garbage and emissions compliance for intended regions.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Route- and flag-specific regulatory matrix and treatment/discharge evidence.

hard_constraints.description: Draft, air-draft, anchorage, port, tender and weather-window access.
hard_constraints.evidence_needed: Geospatial route/port constraints and operating-envelope verification.

assumptions.statement: Economic low-speed displacement operation yields better mission energy than a design optimised for maximum speed.
assumptions.falsification_method: Compare validated resistance/propulsor maps across candidate hulls, loading, fouling and sea states.

assumptions.statement: A battery-buffered electric bus can improve quiet operation and engine dispatch without violating range or mass constraints.
assumptions.falsification_method: Close an hourly power and energy budget including reserve, redundancy, thermal controls and battery mass.

assumptions.statement: Wind assistance can deliver net benefit after stability, rig mass, operating limits and maintenance are counted.
assumptions.falsification_method: Use route/wind distribution, rig performance data, structural loads and matched voyage simulations.

provenance.title: Hurtigruten Sea Zero project page
provenance.scope: Project-specific reported concept features, R&D and energy-reduction claims; comparator anchor only, not independent in-service data.

provenance.title: IMO SDC 12 ship-design and construction workplan
provenance.scope: Published workplan milestones for safety frameworks concerning selected energy-transition technologies; must re-check before approval.

provenance.title: IMO passenger ship safety and environmental standards
provenance.scope: Public overview of applicable passenger-ship safety and MARPOL requirements; not a compliance checklist.

provenance.title: ITTC Practical Guidelines for Ship CFD Applications
provenance.scope: Reference for ship CFD verification, validation, uncertainty and applicability; exact test data/use rights must be checked.

claim_ceiling: Concept hypothesis only. No resistance, displacement, stability, range, emissions, safety or class-compliance result is established.
